subject.title: fix(providers): honor proxies in model discovery

question: Should canonical HTTPS provider model-discovery endpoints be allowed to traverse an operator-configured environment proxy while custom and local catalog origins remain strict-direct?
rationale: This is an intentional SSRF and outbound-routing trust-boundary choice, not a mechanically provable correction: the implementation scopes it narrowly, but maintainers must decide whether the listed fixed vendor endpoints belong in that proxy-eligible class.

options.title: Accept the bounded trusted-endpoint policy
options.body: Rebase, confirm the canonical endpoint list remains fixed and HTTPS-only, then merge with the existing strict handling for overridden and local origins.

options.title: Keep discovery direct by default
options.body: Reject proxy eligibility for provider catalogs and retain the present fallback behavior on proxy-required networks until a different product policy is chosen.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded trusted-endpoint policy
recommendation.body: Rebase, confirm the canonical endpoint list remains fixed and HTTPS-only, then merge with the existing strict handling for overridden and local origins.
